s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision decline with a posterior segment mass
salient_findings: Declining vision in the left eye
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye
Large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
key_facts: 20-year-old woman
3-year history of a left ciliary body mass
Best-corrected visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses unremarkable in both eyes
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye has grown in size
Ophthalmoscopic examination shows a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology negative for malignant cells
Microscopic findings show a hypovascular myxoid lesion
Immunohistochemical studies show positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision decline with a posterior segment mass
salient_findings: Declining vision in the left eye
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye
Large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
key_facts: 20-year-old woman
3-year history of a left ciliary body mass
Best-corrected visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses unremarkable in both eyes
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye has grown in size
Ophthalmoscopic examination shows a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology negative for malignant cells
Microscopic findings show a hypovascular myxoid lesion
Immunohistochemical studies show positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

differentials: Malignant melanoma of the ciliary body
per_call: Malignant melanoma of the ciliary body

shortlist.label: Medulloepithelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Posterior segment mass with hypovascular myxoid features and positive S100

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 and glial fibrillary acidic protein, consistent with neural crest origin

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 and spindle cell morphology, consistent with Schwann cell origin

shortlist.label: Myxoma of the ciliary body
shortlist.why_kept: Hypovascular myxoid lesion with abundant myxoid stroma

shortlist.label: Glial choristoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive glial fibrillary acidic protein and presence of a posterior segment mass

raw.rationale: The presence of a ciliary body mass with a 3-year history, along with the microscopic findings of a hypovascular myxoid lesion and immunohistochemical studies showing positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein, are more consistent with medulloepithelioma, a rare tumor of the ciliary body.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and clinical features typical of neurofibromatosis

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannomas are typically more vascular and have different immunohistochemical profiles

rejected.label: Myxoma of the ciliary body
rejected.why: While myxoma could explain the myxoid appearance, the clinical and histological features, including the location and growth pattern, are more suggestive of medulloepithelioma

rejected.label: Glial choristoma
rejected.why: Glial choristomas are rare, benign tumors that do not typically present with the aggressive growth pattern described
